==================
Bare exit/loop/break not consuming next func definition
==================

	func funcA
		exit
	func funcB
		loop
	func funcC
		break
	func funcD
		see "ok"

---

(source_file
  (class_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (function_definition
      name: (identifier)
      (exit_statement))
    (function_definition
      name: (identifier)
      (loop_statement))
    (function_definition
      name: (identifier)
      (exit_statement))
    (function_definition
      name: (identifier)
      (see_statement
        (string)))))
